id: \bBrandon: So I see you decided to come after all. No point in keeping you waiting then.
en: \bBrandon: So I see you decided to come after all. No point in keeping you waiting then.
it: \bBrandon: Vedo che alla fine hai deciso di venire. Allora è inutile farti aspettare.

id: \bBrandon: I thought you would show me your power, but I feel as though both of us didn't give it our all.
en: \bBrandon: I thought you would show me your power, but I feel as though both of us didn't give it our all.
it: \bBrandon: Pensavo che mi avresti mostrato la tua forza, ma ho la sensazione che nessuno dei due abbia dato il massimo.

id: \bCome back soon and I'll be ready. I hope you will be too.
en: \bCome back soon and I'll be ready. I hope you will be too.
it: \bTorna presto e io sarò pronto. Spero lo sarai anche tu.

id: \bBrandon: I've finished my preparations. Now let me give you the ultimate challenge.
en: \bBrandon: I've finished my preparations. Now let me give you the ultimate challenge.
it: \bBrandon: Ho terminato i miei preparativi. Ora lascia che ti metta di fronte alla sfida definitiva.
\bBrandon: Ti sei guadagnato il Simbolo Coraggio.

id: \bWith this Symbol you have completed the Battle Frontier and now qualify as a Frontier Brain candidate.
en: \bWith this Symbol you have completed the Battle Frontier and now qualify as a Frontier Brain candidate.
it: \bCon questo Simbolo hai completato il Parco Lotta e ora sei idoneo come candidato Asso del Parco.

id: \bBeing a candidate means that you will get the next opening when one of the Brains steps down. Until then, continue to grow as a Trainer.
en: \bBeing a candidate means that you will get the next opening when one of the Brains steps down.  Until then, continue to grow as a Trainer.
it: \bEssere un candidato significa che otterrai il prossimo posto libero quando uno degli Assi si ritirerà. Fino ad allora, continua a crescere come Allenatore.

id: \bI've also prepared a gift for you as celebration. It will be out in the lobby.
en: \bI've also prepared a gift for you as celebration. It will be out in the lobby.
it: \bTi ho anche preparato un regalo per festeggiare. Lo troverai nell'atrio.

id: \bCongratulations on winning. That was your last challenge, was it not? Probably a good idea to head home and tell everyone about it.
en: \bCongratulations on winning. That was your last challenge, was it not? Probably a good idea to head home and tell everyone about it.
it: \bCongratulazioni per la vittoria. Era la tua ultima sfida, non è vero? Forse è una buona idea tornare a casa e raccontarlo a tutti.
